connectivity_interruption_forensics.event_description: Network interruption occurred during Sprint 16 execution.
connectivity_interruption_forensics.impact_on_git: No repository corruption or dangling commits. Both feature and final commits reached remote.
connectivity_interruption_forensics.impact_on_artifacts: Delivery manifest was generated prior to commit finalization, causing base commit SHA reuse in metadata.
connectivity_interruption_forensics.remediation: Multi-stage delivery identity protocol established; manifests regenerated with verified SHAs.
